definitions: Heavy objects, typically made of metal, attached to a ship or boat by a cable or chain and cast overboard to hold it in a particular place by digging into the seabed.
People or things that provide stability or support.
The last runner in a relay race.
A person who presents a television or radio programme, especially the main presenter of a news programme.
examples: She was the anchor of the family.
He ran the anchor leg of the race.
The news anchors reported live from the scene.
